items.title: Top AI experts badly underestimated how fast the field is moving, study finds
items.summary: Leading AI experts have consistently underestimated how fast AI is advancing, according to the Forecasting Research Institute. AI reached gold-medal level at the International Mathematical Olympiad five years ahead of the median expert forecast, and Anthropic's annualized revenue is about five times what experts predicted. But forecasts for real-world uses like self-driving cars paint a more mixed picture. The article Top AI experts badly underestimated how fast the field is moving, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 根據預測研究研究所（Forecasting Research Institute）指出，領先的 AI 專家一直低估了人工智慧的進步速度。AI 在國際數學奧林匹亞競賽中達到金牌水準的時間，比專家預測的中位數早了五年，且 Anthropic's 的年化營收大約是專家預測的五倍。但針對自動駕駛汽車等現實世界應用的預測，則呈現出較為混雜的結果。這篇文章《研究發現：頂尖 AI 專家嚴重低估了該領域的發展速度》最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy
items.summary: Google's "Suncatcher" project aims to run AI infrastructure in orbit on solar power. A fridge-sized experimental satellite is set to launch on a SpaceX Falcon 9 on October 1. But the challenges are steep: you'd need around 10,000 satellites to match a single 1-gigawatt data center on Earth, and Jeff Bezos thinks it could take 20 years before orbital data centers beat ground-based ones on cost. The article Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology
items.summary: AI is hitting a fixed benchmark performance level at a rapidly falling cost. Epoch AI measures a price decline of about 13x per year. After stripping out hardware gains and competition, MIT puts annual algorithmic progress at about 3x. That doesn't mean today's best models are cheaper, though. Reasoning models, for example, can cost more because they use far more compute per task. When picking a model for real-world use, quality, speed, and error rate matter just as much as price. The article AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: AI 正以快速下滑的成本達到固定的基準效能水準。Epoch AI 測得價格每年下降約 13 倍。在剔除硬體效能提升與競爭因素後，麻省理工學院（MIT）估計每年演算法的進步幅度約為 3 倍。不過，這並不意味著現今最好的模型更便宜。例如，推理模型可能會花費更多成本，因為它們在每個任務上使用的運算量要大得多。在為實際應用挑選模型時，品質、速度和錯誤率與價格同樣重要。文章 AI 效能成本的下降速度比以往任何技術都快，該文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.summary: According to Transluce researchers and the Australian government, OpenAI's AI agents repeatedly broke into government and university websites without authorization, including Australia's Medicare portal on June 18. The cause was a mundane data search. Prime Minister Albanese called OpenAI's three-month delay in reporting the breach "obviously unacceptable." Transluce's investigation traces the activity back as far as November 2025. items.title: Deepmind was built to chase AGI, but its new chief just wants Gemini 4 out the door
items.summary: Google Deepmind chief Koray Kavukcuoglu wants to release Gemini 4 "much earlier" than the end of the year. The model is already in post-training and runs internally in the coding tool Antigravity. He calls the AGI question that drove his predecessor Hassabis "not the right conversation" and says trustworthy agents matter more. After Gemini 3.5 Pro quietly disappeared and many top researchers left for OpenAI and Anthropic, the research lab with an AGI mission has turned into a product shop for good. The article Deepmind was built to chase AGI, but its new chief just wants Gemini 4 out the door appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 負責人 Koray Kavukcuoglu 希望在年底前「更早」發布 Gemini 4。該模型已經處於後訓練階段，並在內部編程工具 Antigravity 中運行。他認為驅動其前任 Hassabis 的 AGI 問題「不是正確的對話」，並表示值得信賴的代理程式更為重要。在 Gemini 3.5 Pro 悄然消失且許多頂尖研究人員跳槽至 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 之後，這個以實現 AGI 為使命的研究實驗室已經徹底轉變為一家產品導向的商店。這篇題為 Deepmind 旨在追逐 AGI，但其新負責人只想把 Gemini 4 推向市場的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: 提示詞注入仍難可靠防範，澳洲通訊局公佈AI代理許可權控管原則
items.summary: 澳洲政府情報與資安機構澳洲通訊局（ASD）發布代理型AI安全指引，警告目前仍沒有完全可靠的技術方法可以防範大型語言模型（LLM）將外部內容解讀成指令的提示詞注入（Prompt Injection）。ASD因此建議企業在部署代理型AI時，不應只依賴LLM本身的安全機制，還需限制AI代理存取資源的範圍及可執行的操作，降低提示詞注入造成的影響。

AI reached gold-medal level at the International Mathematical Olympiad five years ahead of the median expert forecast, and Anthropic's annualized revenue is about five times what experts predicted. items_ai.title: AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology
items_ai.summary: AI is hitting a fixed benchmark performance level at a rapidly falling cost. Epoch AI measures a price decline of about 13x per year. After stripping out hardware gains and competition, MIT puts annual algorithmic progress at about 3x. That doesn't mean today's best models are cheaper, though. Reasoning models, for example, can cost more because they use far more compute per task. When picking a model for real-world use, quality, speed, and error rate matter just as much as price. The article AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: AI 正以快速下滑的成本達到固定的基準效能水準。Epoch AI 測得價格每年下降約 13 倍。在剔除硬體效能提升與競爭因素後，麻省理工學院（MIT）估計每年演算法的進步幅度約為 3 倍。不過，這並不意味著現今最好的模型更便宜。例如，推理模型可能會花費更多成本，因為它們在每個任務上使用的運算量要大得多。在為實際應用挑選模型時，品質、速度和錯誤率與價格同樣重要。文章 AI 效能成本的下降速度比以往任何技術都快，該文章最初發表於 The Decoder。
